shortDescription: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he is concerned the nation will be put in a "very bad position" if it does not lead the AI race.When asked by media at the Dallas airport about whether he was concerned if AI will lead to human extinction, he said "no, I don't have any."

children: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he is concerned the nation will be put in a "very bad position" if it does not lead the AI race.
When asked by media at the Dallas airport about whether he was concerned if AI will lead to human extinction, he said "no, I don't have any."
